payload.text: When issue 0326 lands (the core's dev/opt/brew for a project's own binaries, run as bin/devbin install and bin/devbin use in a tool's checkout): tell pipeliner-sc, whose decision 91 holds Pipeliner's CLI to no switch of its own, so pipeliner-cc takes up the core's; tell pplr-vc, cldr-vc and ccusage-vc, whose pplr#0001, cldr#0001 and ccusage#0007 adopt it, with no tool keeping a use or install verb; and have the vcs of Utilz, Molt and Gtools file their adoptions (decision 150). Intent too, while it vendors devbin (decision 150).
